title: Take the challenges
body: Four short challenges, each about 10 minutes. No prior knowledge needed.

title: Meet the team
body: Watch short videos from people already doing the job, and see where it could take you.

title: Enter your details
body: Tell us who you are so we can contact you if you win.

title: Win big
body: The best entries win prizes, plus a fast-track place on the graduate programme.
